prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Desk Companion", "Select the personality and look that best matches your workspace vibe."]
1: ["Mastering Your Desktop Companion", "Learn the basic gestures to interact, reposition, or hide your companion anytime.", "Click pet to interact | Drag pet to reposition | Right-click to hide", "Got It!"]
2: ["Find Your Ideal Desk Partner", "Answer two quick questions so we can match you with the perfect companion archetype.", "See My Recommendation"]
3: ["Your Companion Has Arrived!", "Your desktop pet is now active on your screen. Click below to start interacting.", "Start Playing"]
4: ["Note: Sign in with your existing account email to keep your previous pets and achievements intact."]
5: ["Hatching Your Desktop Companion...", "Did you know? You can right-click your pet on the desktop to change its outfit!"]
6: ["Upload a Clear, Well-Lit Photo", "For best results, use a front-facing photo with good lighting and a simple background.", "Supported formats: JPG, PNG. Avoid blurry or dark images for accurate pet generation."]
7: ["Give Your New Companion a Name", "What should your desk pet be called? You can change this anytime later.", "Companion Name", "Confirm Name"]
8: ["Welcome to Your New Desktop World", "Adopt a digital companion that lives right on your desktop, keeps you company, and brightens your workday."]
9: ["You will receive a desktop notification when your pet finishes hatching!"]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal information by requiring a photo of the user.
